findings.text: skipping every cited merge makes a citation list of merges alone measure zero paths, so a run whose content landed inside a merge is charged nothing and that hole is silent now that the merge-attribution refusal is gone.

added and removed are now summed over the cited commits rather than read from one span diff, so a multi-commit run's recorded changed_lines counts churn the previous measurement netted out, changing a fleet-wide metric beyond the merge case.
assert stored["commits"] == cited compares the record against the same list the test passed in, an echo of its own input rather than an independent expectation, so it guards nothing about the change.
